items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: With all the boys, Buster, and Ralph, Duches and he and everyone else

ctx.x: And he left Jap Allen's orchestra to travel with us. And when we got to New York, apparently he claimed, it surprised me ever so much, he said to me, "Briggs," he said, "What kind of man is this Sissle?" I said, "He's okay.with me," I said, "So far," and I said, "With all the boys, Buster, and Ralph, Duches and he and everyone else, so we never had any complaints about him."
So, he said, "Well, he promised to pay me a certain price, and he didn't live up to his promise." He said, "Look, Briggs, his head is worth ten cents a pound to me." (Laughter).
